name: Nekomori Miiya
source:
Favorite Food: train obentos
Skills: she is good at nothing

Mike's mother, she is a famous actress and looks like she is in her early 20's. Outside of acting, she is completely useless and doesn't even come home. Her personality is unbearable, she is constantly bringing Mike trouble.
